title: Darth Sion
subtitle: Lord of Pain
text:
When Played: Give an Experience token to this unit for each enemy unit that was defeated this phase.
When Defeated: If this unit had 7 or more power, return him to his owner's hand.
rules:
Darth Sion's "When Defeated" ability references his power when he was defeated, which includes temporary modifiers.
Darth Sion's "When Defeated" ability only returns him to hand if he is in the discard pile when it resolves.
